reviews.text: Dr. Daniel is the best veterinarian I've ever known, he's been taking care of my Kiara since she was a puppy ❤️🐶

Terrible reception service. Communication failures and little interest in doing a good job. I believe that's not the good first impression any environment wants to give. (I know semi-intensive care requires extra care, but I only traveled 40km because YOU confirmed there was a vacancy for him!)

People who deserve a 1000/10 rating!

I really like the team and management at the clinic. They are trustworthy and polite.
I recommend them.
Excellent. Juliana welcomed me very well; it was my first time here and we loved it. We will definitely be back. Everyone was very friendly and attentive.

I can't thank Dr. Daniel and his team enough. My four-legged son was so sick, I thought I was going to lose my dog. Thank God, thanks to Dr. Daniel and his entire team, my dog ​​is doing great.

Bathing hospitalized, debilitated, or anesthetized animals can put their health at risk, depending on their clinical condition. The patient's well-being should always come first, and this type of decision should only be made by a veterinarian when truly necessary. If you love your pet, look for places that prioritize their recovery and safety over aesthetics.

We found the clinic through a recommendation, and I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for all the attention and care our dog received from Dr. Ariane, Dr. Daniel, and the entire team. Our dog was already 12 years old, and we started taking him to the clinic at the beginning of this year. He had restricted mobility, was losing weight, and had a lot of tartar on his teeth. Dr. Daniel successfully removed the tartar, we had tests done, and Stark (a Shetland Sheepdog) was diagnosed with canine Alzheimer's and/or dementia. Over the months, he stopped walking, lost even more weight, and began receiving palliative care. Dr. Daniel ordered a cranial ultrasound, which revealed brain cancer with an irreversible condition. Throughout our time at the clinic, Stark was treated with great care and professionalism during consultations, sample collection, and when he needed IV fluids—all with a humane approach that comforted us. We already knew that at some point in the not-too-distant future our dog would leave us, and Dr. Daniel gave us all the support we needed to get through this moment. Stark was a member of our family, intelligent, cheerful, loyal, and a great companion; in those 12 years he was part of my son's childhood, adolescence, and the beginning of his adult life. We will miss him and love him forever!

PET VET Clinic, thank you so much!!!
Excellent professionals!
Thank you ☺️
Excellent professional and service.
Dr. Daniel is a very good person, an excellent professional, always very attentive.
Thanks

I took my dog ​​there for a bunch of tests at the request of a veterinarian I'd been seeing for a while... When I arrived, there were a lot of people, the clinic was packed, I thought "well, they're going to forget some tests," then Dr. Thais, Júlia or Nathalie (forgive me for not remembering exactly), a doctor who does red-coat collections, came by, and she was incredible. She said that because of the number of tests, she would follow up to see if all the samples had been collected. At that point, I felt an enormous amount of affection, respect, and professionalism, because there were quite a few tests... Well, in the reception area, seeing all the people coming and going, I started asking people, and everyone, EVERYONE, talked about Dr. Daniel, that he was incredible. I saw dogs and cats coming in, going out, going for surgery, going for grooming, and I said, "Wow, I want to see Dr. Daniel too." When I talked to him, I understood why people like him so much. He's direct, no beating around the bush, he's knowledgeable, he looked at the problem and that's it, without trying to sell tests, without trying to sell medications, straight to the point, focused on the patient, which... It's the dog, and I felt so safe and confident that I abandoned the old clinic I used to go to. It only took a few minutes for me to see that the doctor was really interested in my dog, even though he was kind of a "street dog," with an uneven haircut, and spoiled. But he was looked at like any other dog, because there had been places I took him where people didn't care because he wasn't a purebred or his coat wasn't in good condition. But there, from the sample collection to the treatment, he was seen for who he is: an animal patient! And now I'm taking my dog ​​there, I've been about 3 or 4 times already, and I'm going back again to repeat exams and have surgery, and I also want to take him for grooming, because everyone who takes their dog there raves about it, and there are SO MANY PEOPLE, haha... And I wanted to highlight how happy I am to see such a committed team, so passionate about what they do, from the reception with Valéria and Erika, all the veterinarians I've had contact with, the super friendly X-ray lady, the super attentive ultrasound doctor... wow, everyone simply treated us SO well, and my dog ​​had EVERYTHING done, from simple to more complex exams, and it was SENSATIONAL! Dr. Daniel deserves congratulations for being who he is and for having such a committed team, you are all incredible, seriously. There are only 533 reviews here on Google, but I must have seen at least 40 people on my visits and I made a point of talking to them, and they were all very satisfied and happy with the care given to their canine and feline children. Congratulations everyone, seriously. In my dog's 13/14 years, I've never seen a clinic with people so happy doing what they love, and I've been to many, because I'm really very critical, but I felt very safe there. Big hug to all. And if you're reading this wondering whether or not to take them, remember that just like us, unforeseen events can happen, and we have to separate things. There are many people there because the service is excellent. What I saw there in those 3 or 4 times were extremely qualified professionals committed to their profession. Congratulations! It gives you so much peace of mind to find a place like that to take care of someone you know can't speak, so thank you very much.

Excellent service, the staff is super attentive, responsible, and everything is very hygienic. You see someone constantly cleaning and taking care of the surroundings. All the professionals were excellent. Congratulations.

I am eternally grateful to Dr. Daniel and the entire Pet Vet team!
At the beginning of the year, I started taking my dogs to the clinic because it was close to home. Dr. Daniel instilled a lot of confidence in us from the start, so we became clients.
I needed to leave my dog ​​Luna hospitalized twice, and everyone on the team was extremely helpful, giving me information, performing exams, giving me exam results, and keeping me informed of all the measures taken for the best interests of my little one.
Unfortunately, Luna passed away during her last hospitalization, but we were always very well supported by everyone at Pet Vet, who made sure everything was as painless as possible.
I am eternally grateful for all the care you gave my Luna and me, from the receptionists to the doctors and hospitalization staff.
Thank you so much <3

He was hospitalized for 18 days, underwent several tests with different specialists, and the clinic even took care of the logistics of tests that are not performed in-house. Throughout his hospitalization, the team took excellent care of him and of us; I have no words to express my gratitude.

Daniel is an exceptional professional, but it would be unfair to praise only him. The entire team is made up of excellent professionals. Dr. Ariane, in particular, has unparalleled sensitivity and extensive knowledge in the field. I wish them all much success in their careers and in life in general, because they deserve the world. 🥰🥰😋gratitude …

Today I come here with a heart full of gratitude to thank each of you for all the affection, care, attention, and dedication you have shown Coração during this second visit.
In moments like this, we realize even more the difference that committed and humane professionals make in our lives. Therefore, I want to give special thanks to the Inpatient Team, who welcomed Coração with so much love, patience, and care, treating him as a member of their own family.
My special affection goes to Laura, who demonstrated a sensitivity and care that I will never forget. I extend this gratitude to the entire team, who dedicate themselves daily to providing comfort, dignity, and well-being to these pure and special beings, regardless of their age or the condition in which they arrive. This empathetic gaze makes all the difference for those who love their animals as part of the family.
And it is impossible not to mention Dr. Daniel. There are excellent professionals, but there are those who transform their profession into a life mission. You are one of those people. Your dedication, your generosity, and your genuine love for animals are evident in every action. Seeing the care, concern, and time you dedicated to Coração brought us security and hope at such a delicate moment. That is priceless.
Knowing that Coração was cared for and continues to be cared for by such special people brings us peace, comfort, and the certainty that he is surrounded by the best professionals and, above all, by great human beings.
My sincerest thanks for every gesture of affection, for every attention, for every care, and for all the love you put into what you do. You don't just take care of animals; you also take care of the hearts of those who love them.
You are truly special!
Sandra and Coração.
I loved the service, I went through Pet Love, I've been there twice already and received excellent service. Dr. Daniel's service was very good.

Thank you very much, Dr. Daniel, for all your commitment, excellence, and dedication! Your work deserves all the recognition and admiration.
I also extend my thanks to Ariane, that's her name, if my memory serves me right, who greeted us the first time at the Clinic, and to the entire team, who contribute to such a welcoming and differentiated service.
I highly recommend! 🐾
Sandra and Coração!

Excellent clinic! Dr. Daniel is wonderful, always in a good mood and treating patients with care. The girls on the team are also always very polite.
I highly recommend it!!

Honestly, I didn't have such a good experience with the clinic. My cat, Boludo, was losing weight rapidly and had diarrhea. I took him to another vet, and it was a disaster. They prescribed medication that didn't help at all and didn't even consider a possible cancer. Disappointed and desperate, I went to this clinic because it was close to home and had good reviews. The clinic itself is well-structured, the service is good, and Dr. Daniel is very attentive and explains the situation in detail. He explained that Boludo needed a biopsy of his intestine to analyze and see if medication or chemotherapy was necessary. We proceeded with the biopsy and hospitalization, and everything went well until then. Things only went downhill when they stopped sending daily updates; they sent one every other day, if that... And when we picked him up from the hospital, they told us to give him the medication and wet food, but they didn't say when we should return to have his stitches removed. We found it strange, but we continued with the medication and the diet. About 15 days passed and the biopsy results came back, but they took a long time to schedule a follow-up appointment. When the follow-up appointment finally happened, they didn't even remove his stitches, they did tests, and once again, it took a long time for the results to come back, and they took so long to schedule an appointment with the oncologist that it became unnecessary to schedule it anymore because Boludo ended up dying suddenly. What disappointed me was this lack of organization and communication between the clinic and the owner. It's true that chemotherapy wasn't going to guarantee that my cat would recover, but at least it would be an attempt. Now, thinking that he could have lived a little longer if it weren't for this delay in response leaves me devastated...
Once again, the clinic is attentive and Dr. Daniel is very attentive too, but this lack of organization/communication can greatly affect the treatment and cost the pet's life.
Always very careful.

I've been a client for years. Dr. Daniel is a very humane person, concerned about animals, an incredible professional. I have complete confidence in his care for Chica and Giogio. Anna at reception is also a sweetheart, and all the nursing staff are super attentive to the animals.

I've been taking my pets there for at least 10 years.

Unprepared to receive cats, terrible service, long and cramped waiting time: I won't be back. If you are a cat owner, I do not recommend it.
excellent service

January 22, 2026:
Regarding my negative review below, I feel obligated to return and inform you that I was contacted by Dr. Daniel, the clinic owner. We discussed what happened, and the doctor offered the possibility of refunding the amount spent or leaving it as credit for future use. He explained the services offered at the clinic and at no point did he say I was wrong in my assessment, nor did he ask me to remove the negative review or to return here to report this incident. The amount spent at the clinic, both the consultation fee and the medication administered, was refunded to me immediately via Pix (Brazilian instant payment system). He said that the doors are open should I need the clinic's services in the future. This, to me, demonstrated that the owner is very concerned about the service offered by his establishment.

January 21, 2026:
They say advice shouldn't be given, but I'll leave some here for anyone desperately looking for a clinic to take their pet to. Stay away from this place and take your pet somewhere else, because there you're just wasting money. You arrive with your pet who vomited all night and the doctor, whose name I don't even know because she's Chinese, turns to you and immediately orders a bunch of tests saying there's a probability of hospitalization. She couldn't do the tests because the pet was skittish, and she also examined the pet in the room with a cat from the clinic, Café, and when she couldn't actually do the tests, she administered some kind of medication to the pet. She didn't give any prescription saying what she administered, no treatment protocol, she simply told me to come back to have the tests done with anesthesia by the anesthesiologist. I went to this clinic paying privately, it wasn't through insurance, and I say that even if it had been free it would have been expensive! Fortunately, my pet is being treated at another clinic with a real professional.

The hygiene of the place should be improved; the urine smell is very strong. My pet was hospitalized and they returned him to me completely covered in urine. During visits, I questioned the cleanliness, and the veterinarian said she would let me know to clean him (something that shouldn't even be requested). When he was discharged, they returned him to me completely dirty and smelling bad… The veterinarians' care was very good, and he recovered very well. I appreciate the care, but I would like to point out that hygiene needs improvement.

Henriqueta and I loved Dr. Ariane Santos, she was very attentive. We went there for a consultation to get vaccinated.
The clinic's physical space is beautiful and well-sanitized. The reception area is quite small for a larger flow of patients (Nothing that invalidates my 5 stars).
Excellent veterinary hospital. Dr. Daniel is very experienced and attentive! Very good facilities for consultations, exams, and hospitalization. I recommend it to everyone!
They are the best in the region! Unmatched! 🫶 …

Quick service and a super pleasant environment.
The doctor was very attentive in everything she had to say about my kittens. I just wish she had examined the basics more, such as gums, ears, etc., which is usually done as standard in other clinics.
The prices are great compared to the area.
The clinic does not perform microchipping.
So grateful!! The greatest reward is seeing her so playful on the acupuncture table ❤️❤️❤️❤️🥳 …

I was well attended to and well treated by Dr. Daniel and the other veterinarians, with the exception of one veterinarian who didn't provide good service and seemed to lack interest and empathy... If your pet is a cat, I advise you to look for another place, but I believe that when I took mine, they did the best they could.

Disorganized. I went twice and it went wrong. On one of those occasions, they thought they were doing an exam, but when we got there, they discovered they weren't. My cat was drugged and starved for nothing.

My initial experience was great! But the second time, when my cat got sick and was hospitalized after feeling unwell, the doctor refused to investigate her condition, saying she seemed fine. He even said I didn't want to accept his suggestion, which embarrassed me. I had asked for tests to be done! Furthermore, I was trying to explain the situation to him, but he wouldn't listen or let me speak, ignoring me and looking at his phone. So, I couldn't question his procedures or those of his team? I also thought: Do I not want to accept (as he said), or does he not like being questioned or asking questions? Because saying it's normal for a cat to vomit every week, and even blood, is at the very least a lack of responsibility and knowledge, or perhaps he simply didn't want to treat her anymore. He discharged her after stabilizing her, and when I went to pick her up, he refused to see me, completely ignoring me at reception, leaving the prescription ready with a referral to another doctor. It's understandable that he didn't want to treat her anymore, but he should have shown some education and respect. Conclusion: Don't question or ask anything, because the doctor in question doesn't like to be contradicted. On the other hand, it was good because two people from my building had told me they lost their pet at that clinic. So I'm grateful for the relief. Now her exams have been done and she's being treated by a professional.

My reply to your response:
But as a clinician, you did NOT do what you could, you didn't even do basic exams. You claimed that to do the exams she needed to be sedated: then I questioned: she never needed to be sedated to do exams and besides, she had been without food for 15 hours, so I suggested feeding her and then doing the exams after 8 hours; because her stress was also due to the time she had been without food. Furthermore, you wanted to sedate a totally debilitated animal, because she had vomited blood, you couldn't even give her an IV. So you didn't do what you could!!!
Excellent service and good professionals.

Hello. Good afternoon! I would like to express my sincere gratitude for the care and quality service always provided by the entire team and the veterinarians, Daniel, He... Marley underwent third eyelid surgery and is doing great, thank you so much ❤️
The service was cordial from the reception staff to Dr. Daniel, who always took such good care of our kitten Betina. My gratitude to the entire team. I trust and recommend them without hesitation.
After the renovation, the space became great, much more professional. The prices are fair and the service is attentive.
This clinic is very attentive, performs all exams on-site, and carried out all procedures on my pet with great care. I highly recommend them.
Dr. Daniel was very attentive and treated us with great care. The clinic is very good, the staff are friendly and smiling. It makes all the difference in a caring environment.

Terrible experience taking my pet to this place! I received very poor service, from the first visit until my return! I felt cheated, embarrassed... This place is a DISAPPOINTMENT! I wouldn't recommend it to anyone! #DISAPPOINTMENT!!!!!!

Today, my dog ​​receives cardiac monitoring and other care between hospitalizations at the clinic with the team. And Dr. Daniel is always cordial and humane.

The clinic offers excellent service, a welcoming atmosphere, hygiene, fair prices, etc.
Gratitude to Dr. Daniel and the Pet Vet & Cia Animal Center team 🙏🐶

I want to thank Dr. Daniel for his competence, dedication, affection, and care in treating our dog Buffy! He certainly has a special gift from God! We also thank the entire clinic team! Everyone is very competent and attentive! Congratulations Pet Vet e Cia!!!!

Warning! My cat died on November 23, 2020, due to medical malpractice. The anesthesia killed my kitten. She was 8 years old. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic, which at the time was called Pet City. It's very strange that they changed their name. The veterinarian is rude, insensitive, and incompetent.
I often take my pet, Preta, for acupuncture sessions because she has arthritis and it helps a lot. And there, Dr. Adriana is super attentive.
Attentive and efficient staff, excellent location, I recommend it!

My initial experience was great; the first cat I took was seen by Dr. Ariany, who provided excellent care and treatment. However, on my return visit, I took my other cat, who ended up being hospitalized due to a fever and a possible stomach/intestinal obstruction. The problem started on Sunday when there were no visiting hours and not even a minimal medical report on him. They said that if he didn't show improvement, he would be operated on Monday. I kept texting and calling without getting through to anyone, until I went there at 3 pm, which was when I could leave work, because I didn't know if he was okay or if he had been operated on. When I arrived, he was discharged… okay, great. However, he had a wound on his lower left leg. I asked a nurse about the hospitalization and she informed me that they don't stay alone. When the doctor saw me, I asked about the wound and he told me it was from licking due to my cat's anxiety and that the obstruction was due to a hairball, and that he had already defecated Sunday night. I then questioned him again about the wound, as I have photos and videos from when I took him in and photos and videos from our visit to him during his hospitalization; he didn't have any injuries and that wound was clearly not from licking. Besides not receiving any updates since Sunday, even though it was a case requiring surgery, not responding on Monday, and having to go there to find the clinic wasn't even full, I still believe they know what happened and caused the injury, because previously they told me that if he defecated, they would call us to pick him up, but they made him stay there all morning and half the afternoon alone. Unfortunately, because of this, I now have no confidence in the clinic, I don't recommend it, and I won't return with my pets there. I had liked the service so much that I looked into the plan they accept to get coverage for my animals. However, this kind of attitude is very questionable. It would have been much more acceptable to explain the reason for the injury (he's a restless cat, I would understand).
